title: Safegate registry issuer entry
description: A registry entry records which capabilities are EXPECTED for a specific token, and the evidence for that claim. It is a deterministic lookup, never a classifier. An entry never says a token is safe. It says a named capability is structurally normal for this issuer, and shows why.

address.description: Contract address or mint address, in the chain's canonical casing.

regulated.description: Subject to a financial regulator that constrains its conduct.

archetype.description: Descriptive only. Recorded per entry by a human with evidence. NOT inferred by any classifier at runtime.

expectedCapabilities.description: Capabilities that are structurally normal for this token. A capability listed here resolves to EXPECTED instead of BAD, and the justification is shown to the reader.

justification.description: Why this capability is necessary for this token to function or to comply with law.

constrainedBy.description: What limits the capability. A timelock, a multisig, a regulator, a published policy.

evidence.description: At least two independent items. On-chain observation alone is not sufficient, and documentation alone is not sufficient.

caveats.description: What being on this list does NOT mean. Displayed alongside the entry.

commercialRelationship.description: Any commercial relationship between Decrypto and this issuer. Null means none. Populated automatically into DISCLOSURE.md and shown on the token's page.

reviewDue.description: Entries expire. A stale entry loses EXPECTED status and reverts to normal scoring.
